Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by concluding that Alice Hathaway Lee Roosevelt was the spouse of Theodore Roosevelt, despite missing the subtle contextual distinction that Edith Roosevelt was his spouse during his presidency. The WestSurfer search provided correct information associating the Jenkins Orphanage Band performance with President Theodore Roosevelt. However, the Planner failed to accurately verify the identity of the presidential spouse during his tenure, instead prematurely concluding the task. This involved overlooking contextual cues that could have distinguished Alice Hathaway Lee Roosevelt, who died in 1884 well before his presidency, from Edith Roosevelt, who was his spouse during the time the band played for Theodore Roosevelt's inaugural parade.
